description.value: Verify that each author reference in the first two DocumentReference entries starts with '#' and that the referenced ID matches the ID of a contained resource within the same DocumentReference.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.take(2).resource.where($this is DocumentReference).all(author.reference.startsWith('#') and author.reference.substring(1) in contained.id)

description.value: Verify that every author in the first two DocumentReference entries has a populated display element.
